MINUTES OF THE SPECIAL MEETING
  CITY OF NORWALK
  INTERNATIONAL FRIENDSHIP COMMISSION
  December 8, 2025

Staff Liaison Amber Bulosan called the meeting to order at 5:03 p.m. in Conference Room
3, Norwalk City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard, Norwalk, California. Responding to roll
call were Commissioner Carbajal, Commissioner Flores, Commissioner Gomez, and
Commissioner Salas. Also, present was Ozzie Ramos, Deputy City Manager and
Svetlana Hernandez, Office Assistant I.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

Commissioner Flores motioned for the approval of the minutes of the International
Friendship Commission Special Meeting minutes that was held on November 10, 2025.
Commissioner Gomez seconded the motion.

MOTION CARRIED BY THE FOLLOWING ROLL CALL VOTE:

AYES:  Commissioner Carbajal, Commissioner Flores, Commissioner Gomez,
  Commissioner Salas
NOES:  None
ABSENT: None
ABSTAIN: None

REPORTS

Vision and Mission Statement

Ms. Bulosan reintroduced the draft of the Vision, Mission Statement that was created
during the previous meeting on November 10. Commissioner Flores was invited to
produce any feedback or incorporate any new ideas to include in the draft. Commissioner
Flores had no additional edits for the draft. All Commissioners agreed to version of the
Vision, Mission Statement drafted on November 10.

Selection of Chair and Vice Chair

The selection of Chair commenced, and Commissioner Flores nominated Commissioner
Carbajal, all commissioners voted unanimously, responding to Roll Call and
Commissioner Carbajal accepted the nomination. Nominations for Vice Chair began and
Chair Carbajal nominated Commissioner Gomez; all Commissioners voted unanimously,
responding to Roll Call and Commissioner Gomez accepted the nomination.

Selection of Meeting Recurrence and Time
 All Commissioners agreed to change meeting dates to the second Tuesday of each
month at 5:00 p.m., and the location will be changed to City Hall Conference Room 4,
located at 12700 Norwalk Boulevard, Norwalk, California.

STAFF COMMENTS

No Staff comment

COMMISSIONER COMMENTS

No Commissioner comment

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

No public comment

ADJOURNMENT:

Being no further business to come before the International Friendship Commission, the
meeting was adjourned at 5:36 p.m.

_______________________________
CHAIR
Maria Carbajal
